RETURN POLICY
If your gear doesn't fit or if you don't like it for any reason, State and Liberty accepts any return that is tagged, unworn, and re-sellable within 30 days of the purchase date.Â Additional return notes:
Only gear that is tagged, unworn, and re-sellable can be returned,  unless there are product defects.
Monogrammed items cannot be returned or exchanged.
Tailored items are non-refundable.
Made to Measure and Made to Order items are non-refundable. If you are not satisfied with the fit of your gear, please contact support@stateandliberty.com or the store where you were fitted for guidance on how to proceed.
